definitions.explanation: Removable artificial teeth that replace missing natural ones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{入|い}れ{歯|ば}だ。

examples.english: Before bed, I take out my dentures and clean them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{入|い}れ{歯|ば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わなくて→合う：10466_au⟧、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{硬|かた}い→硬い：01116_katai⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧にくかった。
examples.english: The new dentures didn't fit, so for a while it was hard to eat anything hard.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入|い}れ{歯|ば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take out dentures
- {入|い}れ{歯|ば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧: dentures don't fit
- ⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧{入|い}れ{歯|ば}: a partial denture
- ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧{入|い}れ{歯|ば}: full dentures

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {義歯|ぎし}: denture; the formal and medical term
- インプラント: a dental implant, fixed in the jaw

WATCH OUT:
The reading is ⟦いれば→いる：00495_iru⟧: ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧ becomes ば in this compound.
